issues.title: RagQualityGateReport contract drift across backend/shared-types leads to unsafe frontend casts

evidence.detail: Shared RagQualityGateReport omits backend fields (glossarySelectedContext, datasourceOrchestration, cacheBudget, r6).
Backend RagQualityGateReport includes additional fields beyond shared type.
Controller returns ApiResponse<unknown>, preventing compile-time contract checks against shared types.
Frontend uses `report as unknown as JsonRecord` and snake_case probing (`latest_run`) to compensate for schema variance.

issues.impact: Type safety for a cross-service API is weakened; backend schema changes can ship without compile-time breakage, and frontend must rely on unsafe casts/compat parsing.
issues.fix: Unify on a single shared RagQualityGateReport contract: (1) extend packages/shared-types RagQualityGateReport to include the backend fields actually returned, (2) type RagQualityController responses as ApiResponse<RagQualityGateReport> (and glossary endpoint with its explicit shared subtype), (3) remove `as unknown as` parsing paths in settings-api-client once the unified schema is in place.

final_verdict_basis: Contract parity does not currently satisfy strict TypeScript API safety expectations for backend/frontend/shared-types integration.
